texts:
Week 7 changed two backfields, brought back a third and handed a fourth to one man.

Jordan Mason took over in Minnesota.

Cam Skattebo ran for 124.

Tony Pollard scored three times.

Here is what's still good from Sunday.

Let's go.
#Skol #NYGiants #TitanUp

Jordan Mason played 38 snaps to 15 for Aaron Jones Sr. and ran 15 times for 68 vs IND. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.

Jones aggravated the MCL sprain in his left knee and did not return. Monitor Monday's MRI.
#Skol #ForTheShoe

Cam Skattebo ran 17 times for 124 and a TD at Houston, two weeks after 6 snaps. He felt his hamstring on the 42-yard OT run; the Giants are off in Week 8. RB23 rest of season for me; hold him.

Tyrone Tracy Jr. hurt his hamstring. Drop him for any add.
#NYGiants #HTownMade

Tony Pollard ran 25 times for 129 and 3 TDs vs CLE on 75 percent of the snaps, with Tyjae Spears and Nick Singleton inactive.

That share depends on two backs being out. RB30 rest of season for me; trade him away and ask for an RB2.
#TitanUp #DawgPound

Thursday night first.

Colston Loveland drew 12 targets vs NE, and Cole Kmet's knee injury is season-ending. TE4 rest of season for me, and the tight end work is his alone.

Luther Burden III caught all 4 targets for 130 and a TD. WR22 rest of season for me.
#DaBears #NEPats

Rhamondre Stevenson played 69 percent of the snaps at CHI and caught 5 for 93 and a TD. RB24 rest of season for me; hold him.

TreVeyon Henderson played a season-low 13 snaps. RB28 rest of season for me; hold him as the change of pace.
#NEPats #DaBears

Jonathan Taylor ran 18 times for 95 and a TD at MIN. RB3 rest of season for me.

Seth McGowan took 11 carries for 46 on 20 snaps, a career high. Leave him on waivers.

Daniel Jones threw for 108. Shane Steichen says he stays the starter.
#ForTheShoe #Skol

Woody Marks played 54 of 61 snaps vs NYG and was the only Houston back with a touch, 19 for 66. RB32 rest of season for me; hold him until David Montgomery practices after the bye.

Tank Dell played 14 snaps in his return, one catch for 43.
#HTownMade #NYGiants

Jaylen Warren out-snapped Rico Dowdle 40 to 28 in Paris and ran 18 times for 101. RB16 rest of season for me; hold him.

Dowdle caught all 6 targets, often from the slot. RB35 rest of season for me; a PPR bench back.
#HereWeGo #Saints

Alvin Kamara out-snapped Kendre Miller 32 to 22 and caught 7 for 57 vs PIT. RB41 rest of season for me; hold him.

Miller ran 8 times for 6. Drop him for any add on the list.

New Orleans ran 17 times for 18 yards.
#Saints #HereWeGo

Tee Higgins caught 6 for 148 and a TD at BAL on 7 targets, the same as Ja'Marr Chase. WR16 rest of season for me; sell him and ask for a WR1.

Joe Burrow went 16 of 18 for 249 in the second half. QB5 rest of season for me.
#WhoDey #RavensFlock

Zay Flowers drew 11 targets from Tyler Huntley and caught 8 for 137 and a TD. WR11 rest of season for me.

Derrick Henry ran 17 times for 45 on 51 percent of the snaps. RB8 rest of season for me; hold him.
#RavensFlock #WhoDey

Quinshon Judkins ran 17 times for 96 and 2 TDs at Tennessee. RB20 rest of season for me; hold him.

Dylan Sampson played 32 snaps in his return. Monitor his snap share in Week 8.

KC Concepcion Jr. caught 8 of 10 for 129. Add him, 3 to 6 percent.
#DawgPound #TitanUp

Braelon Allen played 78 percent of the snaps vs MIA with Breece Hall out, 17 carries for 104 and 6 catches. RB42 rest of season for me; hold him until Hall practices.

Omar Cooper Jr. caught 5 for 115 and a TD. Add him, 1 to 3 percent.
#JetUp #PhinsUp

Ollie Gordon II ran 25 times for 103 and a TD on 83 percent of the snaps for Miami's first win. RB45 rest of season for me; add him where he is out there, 2 to 5 percent.

Jaylen Wright left with a quad injury after 8 snaps.
#PhinsUp #JetUp

Bucky Irving ran 24 times for 106 and 2 TDs at Carolina while Tampa Bay ran 49 times for 258. RB14 rest of season for me; hold him.

Baker Mayfield threw 11 passes in his return. Leave him on your bench in one-QB leagues.
#GoBucs #KeepPounding

Bryce Young threw 2 interceptions, took 5 sacks and was pulled for Kenny Pickett down 43-6. QB12 rest of season for me; monitor Dave Canales' word Wednesday.

Chuba Hubbard ran 7 times in the blowout. RB21 rest of season for me; hold him.
#KeepPounding #GoBucs

Josh Jacobs played 52 percent of the snaps in his debut at DET and caught 5 for 55 and a TD. RB22 rest of season for me; hold him.

Matthew Golden drew 12 targets and 165 air yards. WR25 rest of season for me; trade for him, offer a WR3.
#GoPackGo #OnePride

Jahmyr Gibbs played a season-high 90 percent of the snaps vs GB and ran 29 times for 116. The No. 1 back rest of season for me.

Jameson Williams caught 5 for 91 and 2 TDs on 9 targets. WR26 rest of season for me; hold him.
#OnePride #GoPackGo

Christian McCaffrey hurt his thigh at ATL, came back, and played 34 snaps. San Francisco is off in Week 8; monitor the updates.

Kaelon Black had all 3 of the 49ers' carries inside the 5 and scored. Add him as the handcuff, 2 to 5 percent.
#FTTB #DirtyBirds

Jonah Coleman led the Denver backs with 30 snaps off IR, 9 carries for 54. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent.

Jaylen Waddle hurt his chest late and had X-rays. Monitor Wednesday's report.

Trey McBride drew 13 targets, 10 for 111 and a TD.
#BroncosCountry #BirdGang

Kyren Williams out-snapped Blake Corum 37 to 32 at LV and ran 16 times for 99 and a TD. RB10 rest of season for me; hold him.

Puka Nacua played through the calf: 10 targets, 8 for 68 and a TD.
#RamsHouse #RaiderNation

Emanuel Wilson ran 24 times for 100 and a TD vs KC; Zach Charbonnet is eyed for Week 8. Trade Wilson away; ask for a bench receiver.

Kenneth Walker III ran 14 times for 36 with no red zone plays for KC. RB4 rest of season for me; hold him.
#Seahawks #ChiefsKingdom

The misses.

Kenneth Walker III was RB4 for me; 14 for 36.

Bryce Young was QB10; pulled.

Kendre Miller was RB26; 8 for 6.

Cam Skattebo was RB36 and a sit; 124 and a TD.
#ChiefsKingdom #KeepPounding #Saints #NYGiants

Every takeaway, usage note and overreaction from Week 7 is on the site. Monday night goes into Tuesday's waiver run.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy so the waiver calls land in your feed tomorrow, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/leftovers.html?week=7
